test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the idiom that can substitute the underlined group of words.

All the candidates have __strong determination to succeed__
solution:
The correct answer is "**Fire in their bellies**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase** "fire in their bellies"** means that someone has a strong determination or passion for something.
 
• It is often used to describe someone who is highly motivated and driven to succeed.
